study.design: Market monitoring of European hake muscle by fish size
study.origin: Adriatic Sea (stated); method text also says fish were bought from fishermen of Durres
study.market: Central fresh fish market of Tirana (abstract); fishermen of Durres (methods)
study.method: HNO3/H2SO4 digestion; text names both AAS (abstract, methods) and ICP-OES Optima 2100 DV (methods)
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or LOD reported

unresolved: Abstract says the large-fish cadmium mean exceeds the EC limit, but the text says it is within the 0.050 mg/kg limit; the printed mean 0.0432 is below 0.050.
Abstract names AAS while the methods name an ICP-OES (Optima 2100 DV); the instrument actually used is unclear.
Methods mention "fish samples of red mullet" bought from Durres fishermen, contradicting the hake title and the Tirana market statement; likely copied text.
Lead, arsenic and mercury were not measured.
